Behind it rises a large, elaborate altarpiece (reredos) with niches, statues, and paintings, culminating in an arched top. The architecture includes columns, arches, and decorative moldings in warm beige and cream tones. Two bright light sources (possibly lamps or reflections) are visible near the top corners.
